itens.trecho: Um filme muito mal apreciado e incompreendido, que usa humor irónico para veícular uma mensagem séria e dramática contra o uso de drogas. Confesso que comecei a ver este filme com poucas espectativas acerca dele. Eu sabia que era um dos filmes mais aclamados do cinema, para muitos. Mesmo assim, não me deixei entusiasmar com isso.

25 years on, and this Danny Boyle effort has lost little of it's authentic, gritty, potency. Set in mid 1990s Edinburgh it follows the antics of a disparate group of friends whose only goals in life are to survive, maybe get laid, and to take each day as it comes...

Trainspotting (1996) Directed by Danny Boyle Danny Boyle's Trainspotting is sardonic in the truest sense, both in style and story. It doesn't make fun of addiction, doesn't glamorize it, doesn't preach about it.
